response.sql: WITH analyzed_trades AS (SELECT DISTINCT tx.transreg, tr.tradekind FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref), type_counts AS (SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM analyzed_trades GROUP BY tradekind) SELECT tradekind, record_count, record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM type_counts ORDER BY tradekind NULLS LAST;

assumptions.assumption: Each trade record is counted once, even if it has multiple advanced behaviour records.
Traders with a NULL type form a separate group and remain in the overall total.

alternatives.interpretation: Count advanced behaviour records, including multiple analyses of the same trade.
alternatives.sql: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT tr.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref GROUP BY tr.tradekind) SELECT tradekind, record_count, record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM type_counts ORDER BY tradekind NULLS LAST;

alternatives.interpretation: Report only known trader types, excluding NULL types from both counts and the total.
alternatives.sql: WITH analyzed_trades AS (SELECT DISTINCT tx.transreg, tr.tradekind FROM advancedbehavior AS ab JOIN transactionrecord AS tx ON tx.transreg = ab.translink JOIN trader AS tr ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref WHERE tr.tradekind IS NOT NULL), type_counts AS (SELECT tradekind, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM analyzed_trades GROUP BY tradekind) SELECT tradekind, record_count, record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share_of_total FROM type_counts ORDER BY tradekind;
